The 49ers received good news as they prepare to take on one of the NFL’s best defenses in the Vikings.

Star receiver Mike Evans returned to practice on Thursday for the first time since leaving the Oct. 19 game against the Commanders with Achilles tendinitis. San Francisco is practicing in Colorado Springs, Colo., to acclimate to the elevation ahead of Sunday’s game in Mexico City.

Getting Evans back could have big implications on the primetime game between the two teams vying for the NFC’s top seed. The Vikings (7-2) have the NFL’s second-ranked defense in yards allowed per game (273.3), and coordinator Brian Flores has typically given Kyle Shanahan fits over the years with his blitz-heavy scheme.

The 49ers have lost their last two games against the Vikings with Flores as defensive coordinator, scoring only 17 points in road losses in 2023 and 2024. Minnesota leads the NFL in quarterback pressure rate at 46.5% while blitzing on a league-high 72.3% of passing plays, according to Next Gen Stats.

WR Mike Evans (Achilles) is in uniform at 49ers’ practice and there is now looking like a decent chance he will be available to play Sunday night against the Vikings. pic.twitter.com/koigsscnjy

Evans had his biggest game of the season for San Francisco against the only defense that allows fewer yards than the Vikings when he caught seven passes for 113 yards and a touchdown during the Oct. 11 road win against the Seahawks. The future Hall of Famer leads the 49ers averaging 70 receiving yards per game.

Evans has been one of many 49ers wideouts to miss time with injury, yet Shanahan’s team has had one of the NFL’s best offenses throughout the season anyway. San Francisco put up a season-high 584 yards in Sunday’s win over the Cowboys in which Brock Purdy threw for 389 yards and three touchdowns.

Evans has missed three-plus games with the injury, while the 49ers have been without receivers Ricky Pearsall and rookie De’Zhaun Stribling for most of the season. Deebo Samuel just returned from a three-game absence with a hamstring injury, and Demarcus Robinson missed five games with a high ankle sprain.

The team’s injury situation led to San Francisco trading for former Colts receiver Keenan Allen ahead of the trade deadline. Allen had five catches for 61 yards in his 49ers debut against the Cowboys.
news.content:
در نتایج جستجوی خود، اخبار بیشتری از پوشش خبری ما ببینید. تیم 49ers در حالی که برای رویارویی با یکی از بهترین خطوط دفاعی NFL در تیم وایکینگز آماده می‌شود، خبر خوبی دریافت کرد. مایک ایوانز، بازیکن مطرح پست ریسیور، روز پنج‌شنبه برای اولین بار از زمان ترک بازی 19 اکتبر مقابل کاماندرز به دلیل التهاب تاندون آشیل، به تمرینات بازگشت. سانفرانسیسکو در کلرادو اسپرینگز، کلرادو تمرین می‌کند تا قبل از بازی یکشنبه در مکزیکوسیتی با ارتفاع سازگار شود. بازگشت ایوانز می‌تواند تأثیرات زیادی بر بازی مهم بین دو تیمی که برای کسب رتبه اول NFC رقابت می‌کنند، داشته باشد. وایکینگ‌ها (7-2) دومین خط دفاعی برتر NFL از نظر یارد مجاز در هر بازی (273.3) را دارند و برایان فلورس، هماهنگ‌کننده، معمولاً در طول سال‌ها با طرح پربلیتس خود کایل شانهان را به دردسر انداخته است. تیم 49ers در دو بازی آخر خود مقابل وایکینگ‌ها با فلورس به عنوان هماهنگ‌کننده دفاعی شکست خورده است و در بازی‌های خارج از خانه در سال‌های 2023 و 2024 تنها 17 امتیاز کسب کرده است. طبق آمار Next Gen، مینه سوتا با نرخ فشار 46.5 درصدی بر روی کوارتربک در صدر لیگ NFL قرار دارد و در 72.3 درصد از بازی‌های پاس، که بالاترین میزان در لیگ است، از تاکتیک بلایتز استفاده می‌کند. دبلیو آر مایک ایوانز (آشیل) در تمرین 49رز با لباس یکدست است و اکنون به نظر می رسد که او شانس خوبی برای بازی یکشنبه شب مقابل وایکینگ ها دارد. pic.twitter.com/koigsscnjy
ایوانز بزرگترین بازی فصل خود را برای سانفرانسیسکو در مقابل تنها دفاعی انجام داد که یاردی کمتری نسبت به وایکینگ ها می دهد، زمانی که هفت پاس به طول 113 یارد و یک تاچ داون در جریان پیروزی جاده ای 11 اکتبر برابر سی هاوکس گرفت. آینده

Christian Parker nearly took the easy way out of Dallas.

The Cowboys defensive coordinator had his play-calling responsibilities stripped given to defensive assistant Mike Pettine after a 46-40 loss to the 49ers last week,

Head coach Brian Schottenheimer admitted there were a lot of conversations going on this week, including one with Parker about leaving the Cowboys, ESPN NFL reporter Todd Archer reported Thursday.

However, Parker said “that would have been running from it.”

The 34-year-old called the situation a “significant” personal disappointment and said Pettine’s takeover is “only awkward if you make it that way.”

Against the 49ers, the Cowboys allowed 584 yards of offense — the most they have allowed at home in franchise history.

They were also completely fooled by coach Kyle Shanahan’s trick play in the third quarter that brought on a 70-yard touchdown from Deebo Samuel.

Schottenheimer called the defense “unacceptable” after the game and did not give Parker a vote of confidence.  Owner Jerry Jones didn’t have one for him either.

During an interview with 105.3 The Fan on Tuesday, the Jones was asked if the team was looking to make changes to Parker’s role.

“We’re talking about that, but I’m not going to talk about that here. But we are talking about those things,” Jones said.

Parker was a defensive backs coach in Denver and Philadelphia for five seasons before landing the gig in Dallas.

The Cowboys remain in the hunt for the playoffs at 4-6 due to a struggling NFC East. They sit three games behind Giants (5-3-1) in the loss column.

They will be hope Pettine can add some flavor to the defense. He previously served as the defensive coordinator for the Jets, Bills and Packers before taking on the Browns’ head coaching job from 2014-15.

Dallas hosts the 1-8 Titans next week followed by the 2-7 Eagles before visiting the defending Super Bowl champion Seahawks (6-4).

The franchise has missed the playoffs the past two seasons and has not made it to an NFC Championship game since winning the Super Bowl in 1996.
news.content:
در نتایج جستجوی خود، پوشش خبری بیشتر ما را ببینید. کریستین پارکر تقریباً راه آسانی برای خروج از دالاس داشت. پس از شکست 46-40 مقابل 49ers در هفته گذشته، مسئولیت‌های تعیین تاکتیک بازی هماهنگ‌کننده دفاعی کابویز از او گرفته شد و به مایک پِتین، دستیار دفاعی، واگذار شد. تاد آرچر، خبرنگار ESPN NFL، روز پنجشنبه گزارش داد که برایان شاتنهایمر، سرمربی تیم، اذعان کرد که این هفته گفتگوهای زیادی در جریان بوده است، از جمله گفتگویی با پارکر درباره ترک کابویز. با این حال، پارکر گفت «این کار به معنای فرار از مشکل بود.»

All I Want for Christmas Is Booze?

Mariah Carey’s holiday pop-up bar will take over the White Rabbit Sky Lounge at The Valorian on Los Angeles’ Sunset Strip starting Thursday.

Organizers of the “All I Want for Christmas Is You” crooner’s seasonal hangout invite guests to “be fully immersed in the Christmas spirit, surrounded by wall-to-wall Mariah-inspired holiday décor, interactive photo ops throughout.”

“Step into our holiday-themed bar, where the magic is in the atmosphere!” the bar’s website reads.

“The revamped experience introduces exciting new moments, including an upgraded ‘Queen of Christmas’ homage, Santa’s Sleigh photo ops, and a signature award wall alongside album-backdrop recreations.”

Guests can enjoy singalongs to Carey’s songs and even write a letter directly to the Queen of Christmas herself.

Guests can even take sleigh-ride photos set against a winter scene with photos of Carey in the background.

All of this plus exclusive merchandise and a holiday food and cocktail menu, complete with festive cocktails made with the singer’s Black Irish cream liqueur.

The pop-up will run through Dec. 27 for adults 21 and up.

Prices range from $25-$30 for general admission, depending on the time of visit, and include one welcome cocktail.

General admission tickets are standing-room only, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis.

“Each reservation is for a 90-minute festive experience, after which guests will be gently reminded to wrap up their holiday magic,” the site says.

There’s also brunch being served every weekend, with prices starting at $55 for two guests.

For tickets and more information, check out the website.
news.content:
از پوشش ما در نتایج جستجوی خود بیشتر مشاهده کنید. تمام چیزی که برای کریسمس می‌خواهم مشروب است؟ نوار پاپ آپ تعطیلات ماریا کری از پنج‌شنبه، سالن White Rabbit Sky در The Valorian در نوار غروب لس آنجلس را اشغال می‌کند. سازمان‌دهندگان پاتوق فصلی «همه چیزی که برای کریسمس می‌خواهم، تو هستی» از مهمانان دعوت می‌کنند تا «کاملاً در روحیه کریسمس غوطه‌ور شوند، با دکوراسیون تعطیلات دیوار به دیوار الهام‌گرفته از ماریا، و عکس‌های تعاملی در سراسر آن احاطه شده‌اند».
"به نوار تعطیلات ما وارد شوید، جایی که جادو در جو است!" وب سایت بار می خواند. «تجربه‌ی بازسازی‌شده لحظات هیجان‌انگیز جدیدی را معرفی می‌کند، از جمله ادای احترام به‌روزرسانی‌شده «ملکه کریسمس»، عکس‌برداری سورتمه بابانوئل، و یک دیوار جایزه امضا در کنار سرگرمی‌های پس‌زمینه آلبوم.»
بزرگترین اخبار، عقاید و فرهنگ شکل‌دهنده کالیفرنیا در حال حاضر. لطفاً یک ایمیل معتبر ارائه دهید. با کلیک کردن در بالا، با شرایط استفاده و خط‌مشی رازداری موافقت می‌کنید. مهمانان می‌توانند از آهنگ‌های آهنگ کری لذت ببرند و حتی مستقیماً برای خود ملکه کریسمس نامه بنویسند. مهمانان حتی می‌توانند عکس‌های سورتمه‌سواری با صحنه‌های زمستانی با عکس‌های کری در پس‌زمینه بگیرند. همه این‌ها به‌علاوه کالاهای انحصاری و منوی غذا و کوکتل تعطیلات، همراه با کوکتل‌های جشن ساخته شده با ایرلندی‌ها و کرم‌های پاپ‌آپ بزرگسالان. 21 به بالا قیمت ها از 25 تا 30 دلار برای پذیرش عمومی بسته به زمان بازدید متغیر است و شامل یک کوکتل خوش آمدگویی است. آگهی عمومی

A Louisiana creep allegedly forced a young relative to do grueling 12-hour workouts and threatened to cut out his tongue — after the child told him he was gay, according to disturbing court documents.

Prince Daniel Cruz, of West Monroe, was arrested on Tuesday after a child reported abuse by a family member to the Louisiana Department of Children and Family Services.

The victim, who is not identified because of their age, said Cruz physically abused him after he came out to his relative, according to court documents seen by Louisiana First News.

Investigators claim Cruz, who found makeup and a pair of women’s underwear in the relative’s bedroom, flew into a rage and aggressively cut the child’s hair with clippers, leaving him with scrapes on his scalp.

“If you want to wear make-up like a clown, I will make you look like a clown,” Cruz allegedly told the child, before asking if he was ready to show everyone his “beautiful hair.”

Cruz also allegedly subjected the young victim to a grueling workout to physically punish him, forcing him to do 100 burpees, push-ups, sit-ups, and crunches.

Cruz told authorities he had been boxing with the victim and another child since the victim was 5 years old.

DCFS officials said the victim alleged that Cruz forced him and the other child into doing strenuous workouts that lasted for over 12 hours, stopping only for the bathroom and water.

Both children said they didn’t eat much, knowing Cruz would punch them in the stomach and make them vomit.

The court report also detailed a terrifying incident in which the victim described how Cruz allegedly once held a knife to his tongue and threatened to cut it off over a lie.

He also told investigators Cruz believes a spirit named “Jason” speaks to him, and that he claimed it was “Jason” who wanted the tongue, the docs state.

The child also stated that in 4th grade, Cruz whipped him and cut his hair after he forged his signature on a progress report. When a teacher reported it to DCFS, the child said Cruz punished him again.

New York City’s iconic Flatiron Building has officially gone from office landmark to home sweet home.

For the first time in its 124-year history, residents are moving into the famous triangular skyscraper at 175 Fifth Ave., following a highly anticipated transformation into ultra-luxury condominiums, The Post has learned.

And the building’s new residential chapter is already attracting big money.

Six apartments were marked sold on StreetEasy between late October and mid-November, with reported prices totaling approximately $118.6 million — nearly $120 million in just a matter of weeks.

Another 11 units are presently in contract, according to StreetEasy, with their combined listing prices totaling $234.5 million. Those deals have yet to close, and their final sale prices remain unknown.

City property records confirm at least one transaction: a residence that sold for $29.75 million on Oct. 28, according to a deed recorded with the Department of Finance on Nov. 18.

The first sales mark a major milestone for the Beaux-Arts landmark, which opened in 1902 and spent more than a century housing office workers rather than permanent residents.

The Brodsky Organization and Sorgente Group have transformed the building into 36 luxury residences, with interiors by acclaimed designer Studio Sofield.

Residents will have access to a 60-foot lap pool, a fitness center, a sauna, a cold plunge, a golf simulator and lounges overlooking Madison Square Park. The building also features a double-height attended lobby, while private wine cellars and storage units are available for purchase.

The ambitious restoration preserves the property’s historic architectural character while introducing contemporary residential interiors and amenities.

“We can now proudly say that for the first time in its storied history, The Flatiron Building is officially a residential address,” Dean Amro, principal at the Brodsky Organization, told The Post.

“It is especially rewarding to see our buyers share our enthusiasm for the building, and that they are so eager to call it home,” he added.

“As we put the finishing touches on this remarkable transformation, we are encouraged by the strong sales momentum and look forward to welcoming more residents while ensuring the Flatiron Building remains a cherished part of New York City for generations to come.”

Remaining three- and four-bedroom homes start at $14.85 million, while a 20th-floor residence is asking a staggering $53.5 million, according to the development’s latest marketing materials.

The latest milestone comes after a turbulent few years for one of Manhattan’s most recognizable buildings.

In March 2023, the Flatiron became the unlikely star of a dramatic court-ordered auction when investor Jacob Garlick placed a jaw-dropping $190 million winning bid. At the time, the building was the subject of a dispute among its co-owners, who didn’t know what to do with the longtime office property.

But the deal quickly unraveled after Garlick failed to produce the required $19 million deposit, forcing the property back onto the auction block.

Two months later, the owners secured the building with a $161.5 million bid.

The saga paved the way for an ambitious residential reinvention, turning a property once synonymous with Manhattan’s commercial history into one of the city’s most unusual luxury addresses.

The building’s first publicly listed apartment hit the market in January — an 11th-floor residence asking $16 million.

Demand quickly accelerated.

By April, nearly a dozen residences were already in contract, with combined asking prices exceeding $240 million, including a full-floor home listed for $58.5 million.

By August, the landmark was approaching a sellout, with 18 of 22 publicly marketed residences no longer available.

The building’s transformation is part of a broader wave of office-to-residential conversions across New York City, as developers seek new uses for aging commercial properties.

But few conversions come with the history, recognizable silhouette or price tags of the Flatiron.
news.content: پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. ساختمان نمادین Flatiron شهر نیویورک رسماً از نقطه عطف اداری به خانه ای شیرین تبدیل شده است. برای اولین بار در تاریخ 124 ساله خود، ساکنان به دنبال یک تبدیل بسیار مورد انتظار به سمت آسمان خراش مثلثی معروف در خیابان پنجم 175 حرکت می کنند. فصل در حال حاضر جذب پول کلان است. شش آپارتمان بین اواخر اکتبر تا اواسط نوامبر در StreetEasy فروخته شد، با قیمت‌های گزارش شده در مجموع حدود 118.6 میلیون دلار — تقریباً 120 میلیون دلار در عرض چند هفته. طبق گفته StreetEasy، 11 واحد دیگر در حال حاضر در قرارداد هستند و قیمت‌های فهرست شده آنها مجموعاً 234.5 میلیون دلار است. این معاملات هنوز بسته نشده اند و قیمت نهایی فروش آنها مشخص نیست. سوابق املاک شهر حداقل یک معامله را تأیید می کند: اقامتگاهی که در 28 اکتبر به قیمت 29.75 میلیون دلار فروخته شد، طبق سندی که در 18 نوامبر در وزارت دارایی ثبت شد. اولین فروش نقطه عطف مهمی برای بنای برجسته Beaux-Arts است که در سال 1902 افتتاح شد و بیش از یک قرن برای ساکنان دائمی کارمندان دفتر کار کرد. سازمان برادسکی و گروه Sorgente این ساختمان را به 36 اقامتگاه مجلل با طراحی داخلی توسط طراح مشهور استودیو سوفیلد تبدیل کرده‌اند. ساکنان به استخر 60 فوتی، مرکز تناسب اندام، سونا، شنای سرد، شبیه‌ساز گلف و سالن‌هایی مشرف به ما دسترسی خواهند داشت.

Divisive sports broadcaster Dianna Russini quietly removed a photo of her husband and children from an Instagram post on Wednesday, after sharing the image alongside a strong declaration about the future of her career.

Hours after debuting the second episode of her new show on BetUS, Russini, 43, shared a new post on her social media account, featuring a carousel of three images, including a headshot and a snap of some flowers and cards seemingly sent to her in celebration of her latest venture.

In addition, she also included a photo of what appeared to be her bedside table, which was decorated with a framed wedding photo of herself and her husband, Shake Shack exec Kevin Goldschmidt, as well as another of their two children.

Also seen on the table was a note from her management company telling her to “f–king kill it.”

“Feeling loved. Feeling grateful. Back talking football, and I couldn’t do it without the best friends and family in the world. More to come…❤️,” Russini wrote in the caption of the post.

However, hours after sharing the post, Russini quietly removed the image showing the photos of her husband and her children, while leaving the other two intact.

It was not immediately clear what prompted Russini to remove the image; however, she notably limited the comments on the post.

Russini famously stepped down from her role at the New York Times’ The Athletic earlier this year following an investigation into her relationship with New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel.

Page Six has reached out to Russini’s reps for comment.

On Nov. 11, the NFL insider’s new show, “The Russini Report,” premiered on the online sportsbook platform, her first appearance since stepping down from the Times in April.

The show was slated to air live at 12 p.m. ET, but did not air until almost 1 p.m. ET due to an “overwhelming” number of viewers.

During the premiere, she subtly addressed the Vrabel controversy, noting that she’d had a “lot of time” to think about her priorities.

“Over the last few months, I have had a lot of time to think about my life and my priorities and the person I want to be moving forward and being home in New Jersey with my husband and our two little boys and being truly present,” Russini said at the top of the episode.

“It gave me so much perspective that I didn’t even know I needed.”

Russini went on to note that she also used her time away from the spotlight to figure out how to continue her career as an NFL insider, explaining that she’d spoken to several people in the industry — and outside it — to work out what her future might hold.

“I’ve also had a lot of long conversations with people all around football,” she said. “You know, some were about the game and others were just about life to the people who picked up the phone and checked in and offered both encouragement and honest advice, from the bottom of my heart, thank you.”

“Those conversations helped me find my way back to the work I love and back to myself, right here, hosting the show,” the journalist added.

The reporter’s return to the spotlight comes seven months after she resigned from her job at the New York Times’ The Athletic amid an investigation into her relationship with Vrabel.

The investigation was launched after Page Six published exclusive photos of the two cozying up together at an Arizona resort.

Page Six also obtained snaps of them kissing at Tribeca Tavern in New York City years before, in March 2020.

After Russini resigned, Vrabel was absent from Day 3 of the NFL Draft, having revealed that he was going to seek counseling.

The two deny any nefarious behavior, but The Athletic concluded at the end of the investigation that the two shared an inappropriate relationship.

The publication also stated that it “was in clear violation of The Athletic’s standards.”

The two remain married to their respective spouses. Russini has been married to Goldschmidt since 2020, while Vrabel has been married to his wife, Jen, since 1999.

پوشش خبری بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. دیانا روسینی، گوینده ورزشی بحث‌برانگیز، روز چهارشنبه بی‌سروصدا عکسی از شوهر و فرزندانش را از یک پست اینستاگرام حذف کرد، پس از اینکه این تصویر را همراه با بیانیه‌ای قاطع درباره آینده شغلی‌اش به اشتراک گذاشته بود. چند ساعت پس از پخش اولین قسمت از برنامه جدیدش در BetUS، روسینی 43 ساله، پست جدیدی را در حساب رسانه‌های اجتماعی خود منتشر کرد که شامل یک کاروسل با سه تصویر بود، از جمله یک عکس پرتره و تصویری از تعدادی گل و کارت که ظاهراً به مناسبت آخرین فعالیت او برایش ارسال شده بود. علاوه بر این، او همچنین عکسی از چیزی که به نظر می‌رسید میز کنار تختش باشد را نیز قرار داد که با یک قاب عکس عروسی از خودش و همسرش، کوین گلدشمیت، مدیر اجرایی Shake Shack، و همچنین عکس دیگری از دو فرزندشان تزئین شده بود. همچنین روی میز یادداشتی از شرکت مدیریت او دیده می‌شد که به او می‌گفت «باید بترکونی.»
«احساس می‌کنم دوست داشته می‌شوم. احساس سپاسگزاری می‌کنم. دوباره در مورد فوتبال صحبت می‌کنم و نمی‌توانستم این کار را بدون بهترین دوستان و خانواده در دنیا انجام دهم. در ادامه مطلب…❤️»، روسینی در کپشن پست نوشت. با این حال، چند ساعت پس از انتشار پست، روسینی بی‌سروصدا تصویری را که عکس‌های شوهر و فرزندانش را نشان می‌داد حذف کرد، در حالی که دو تصویر دیگر را دست نخورده باقی گذاشت. بلافاصله مشخص نشد که چه چیزی باعث شد روسینی این تصویر را حذف کند؛ با این حال، او به طور قابل توجهی امکان درج کامنت در این پست را محدود کرد. همانطور که می‌دانید، روسینی اوایل امسال پس از تحقیقاتی در مورد رزومه‌اش از سمت خود در The Athletic متعلق به نیویورک تایمز کناره‌گیری کرد.

news.originalContent:
(Credit: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement)

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has removed a criminal illegal alien from El Salvador following violent crime convictions, according to a document obtained exclusively by the Daily Caller.

ICE removed Wilber Jandres, a 44-year-old Salvadoran national, on Nov. 17 following convictions for murder, gang assault, cocaine possession, and promoting prison contraband.

Jandres is also suspected of having ties to MS-13, according to the document.

The President in response to my question regarding some Republicans pushing for immigration reform and what concessions he would be willing to make. @DailyCaller https://t.co/VJltEYFMxk

MS-13, short for Mara Salvatrucha, is a transnational criminal gang that has carried out acts of violence to intimidate and terrorize communities, according to an Obama-era White House executive order and the Treasury Department.

Its criminal activities include machete attacks, executions, gang rape, and human trafficking. (RELATED: FACT CHECK: Is ‘Kill, Rape, Control’ An MS-13 Motto?)

The gang has more than 10,000 members in the United States, spreading violence and suffering as of April 2025, according to a Department of Justice (DOJ) report.

The Daily Caller reached out to ICE for comment regarding Jandres’ conviction and asked about the agency’s ongoing efforts to identify, arrest, and remove MS-13 members from the United States.

In response, ICE Assistant Director of Public Affairs Micah Bock provided the following statement, writing, “ICE continues to relentlessly pursue any and all criminal illegal aliens who are known or suspected gang members. We will not stop until every single one is removed or put behind bars.”

“ICE is not slowing down. As President Trump and Secretary Mullin have made clear, we are working around the clock to identify, arrest and remove threats to Americans, making our communities safer and our nation more secure,” Bock wrote to the Caller.

🧟‍♂️Zombie Amnesty Plan Shambles On In Lame Duck Congress Amid Trump Floating Deal With Democrats The legislation, sponsored by Republican Pennsylvania Rep. Glenn (GT) Thompson, chairman of the House Agriculture Committee, is known as the Securing Agriculture’s Workforce Act of 2026 (SAWA). The bill would in effect grant amnesty to illegal immigrants who work in the agricultural sector. Read more👇@DailyCaller

The Caller also sought an update on the extent of MS-13’s presence in the country nearly two years into the Trump administration’s immigration enforcement efforts and how the agency is prioritizing the removal of gang members and other violent criminal offenders.

“Following the disastrous Biden administration immigration policies, our country has been flooded with illegal aliens. Now, President Trump is cleaning up the mess. ICE has arrested 11,642 suspected gang members and removed 11,001. ICE continues to focus on the worst of the worst, and these criminal illegal aliens remain a top target,” Bock added.

Jandres entered the United States illegally at an unknown date and location, according to the document viewed by the Caller.

He was identified by the Nassau/Suffolk Criminal Alien Program in April 2009 while in custody. Jandres was previously granted temporary protected status (TPS), but lost that status following his criminal convictions later that year. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: GOP Rep Tells DHS To Provide The Receipts For Deportation Numbers)

Jandres has multiple convictions for violent offenses and drug possession. Records also indicate that he was known by the street name “Player.”

Meanwhile, Democratic New York Rep. Timothy Kennedy challenged Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Secretary Markwayne Mullin’s characterization of immigration detainees as the “worst of the worst” during Wednesday’s House Homeland Security Committee hearing, Worldwide Threats to the Homeland: 25 Years After 9/11.

Kennedy argued that the administration’s detention policies extend beyond the most serious criminal offenders, pointing to data on detainees held at a federal facility in his home state.

The New York Democrat cited a July 8 letter he sent to Mullin, to which the secretary responded on Sept. 29. Mullin’s response indicated that more than 70 percent of detainees at the Batavia Federal Detention Facility in western New York had never been convicted of a crime.

Kennedy later reiterated that 72 percent of detainees had never been convicted of a crime, declaring, “That’s not the worst of the worst.” Mullin pushed back, responding, “They did. They entered the country illegally.”

The New York congressman also pointed to a $1.5 billion construction contract to expand detention capacity, arguing that the administration was spending billions to detain people “that no one in good faith would consider the worst of the worst.”

Kennedy further accused the administration of breaking its campaign promise to prioritize the most serious offenders, saying, “That’s not what the president of the United States promised when he was campaigning years ago. ‘We’re going to deport the worst of the worst’ is what he said. And that was a lie.”

Mullin fired back at the New York Democrat, telling him, “So change the laws. You’re a Congressman, you make the laws.”

The secretary defended the administration’s enforcement priorities, maintaining that DHS continues to focus on dangerous criminals. (RELATED: Zombie Amnesty Plan Shambles On In Lame Duck Congress Amid Trump Floating Deal With Democrats)

Mullin cited the removal of approximately 2,705 terrorists or suspected terrorists and more than 20,000 gang members under the administration.

He also argued that entering the country illegally is itself a crime and that individuals without criminal convictions are often encountered as collateral during targeted enforcement operations.

Mullin further blamed sanctuary policies, including those in New York, for increasing the federal government’s reliance on detention. He contended that when state and local officials refuse to honor immigration detainers for individuals with serious criminal records, federal authorities are left with fewer options for handling those individuals.

news.originalContent:
With crowds rallying behind El Salvador’s deployment in Haiti, analysts question whether civilians are any safer.

The streets of Haiti’s capital, Port-au-Prince, rang out on Tuesday and Wednesday with chants from local residents in support of a president who was not their own: El Salvador’s Nayib Bukele. In a country where the scars of foreign intervention run deep, some Haitians are placing their hopes on another foreign force, this time from El Salvador, to help take their neighbourhoods back from armed gangs.

Thousands turned out to cheer on the roughly 2,500 soldiers Bukele has sent since October. What began as a narrow mission to rescue four missing Salvadoran aviation technicians has grown into a much broader military operation.

For some of those who marched, the intervention is exactly what the country needs after years of kidnappings, killings, and displacement, with little sign of relief.

But even with the Haitian government’s backing and a warm reception from the public, questions are growing about what the troops are doing on the ground and what kind of mark Bukele will ultimately leave on Haiti.

The immediate trigger came on October 18, when four Salvadoran aviation technicians working with the United Nations-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF) went missing after armed men attacked their vehicle near Port-au-Prince.

The force was created to help Haitian authorities deal with a security crisis that has grown more severe since the 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moise. According to Reuters, gangs now control more than 80 percent of the capital region, with Haitian and international forces struggling to reclaim that territory.

Shortly after the technicians went missing, Bukele announced a new military operation in Haiti, sending 100 special forces soldiers to rescue them. Since then, he’s sent about 2,500 in total.

Most of them are operating outside the UN-backed force and outside the UN support office’s monitoring mechanisms, according to UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric.

And the deployment itself has turned from a narrow rescue operation to a broader offensive against Haiti’s gangs, with Salvadoran soldiers joining Haitian security forces, the GSF, and private contractors, including Blackwater founder Erik Prince’s Vectus Global.

Bukele, who gained international notoriety for a crackdown on gangs in El Salvador that led to a sharp decline in crime but has drawn widespread condemnation over human rights abuses, has been aggressively promoting the deployment on social media.

He has posted dramatic videos of helicopter attacks on gang leaders’ properties and, more recently, footage of rallies cheering on his troops.

“I never expected anything like this,” he wrote in a Tuesday post accompanying a video of a rally. “I hear you loud and clear. I love you, too.”

Neither the Haitian government nor the Salvadoran government replied to Al Jazeera’s requests for comment about the troops in Haiti.

The troops have landed amid a worsening humanitarian crisis in Haiti, with nearly 1.5 million people displaced from their homes, and violence making it difficult to access food and basic services. More than 22,000 people have been killed in gang-related violence, including security operations, since 2022, according to Reuters.

At rallies in Port-au-Prince and other parts of Haiti, demonstrators voiced support for the deployment. Some who spoke to The Associated Press news agency described losing loved ones to gang violence and being forced to leave their homes.

“The support we see from many Haitians comes from sheer desperation after years of failure and widespread terror,” Louimann Maceus, president of the human rights organisation Ensemble des Citoyens Competents a la Recherche de l’Egalite des Droits de l’Homme en Haiti (ECCREDHH), told Al Jazeera. “People are exhausted.”

“There is a genuine hope, especially among the hundreds of thousands of internally displaced people we work with who just want to return safely home,” said Maceus, who lives in Port-au-Prince.

That hope, he said, follows years of frustration with UN-backed forces, which he said had done little to improve security.

The Salvadoran deployment already outnumbers the GSF, according to numbers from the GSF’s special representative Jack Christofides, on October 18, when it had just surpassed 2,000 personnel.

International Crisis Group analyst Diego Da Rin also links some of the enthusiasm to what he describes as a really effective communication campaign by Bukele, whose videos of strikes on gang leaders’ homes are all over Haitian social media.

“These are symbolic wins that everybody was waiting for,” he said, adding that AI-generated videos were also circulating of gang leaders being arrested.

But support for the deployment is not universal. Da Rin pointed to the residents of gang-controlled areas.

“Many of these people, who clearly see the risks in these iron-fist operations, are extremely scared of being attacked and being collateral damage of any of these operations,” said Da Rin.

Security force clashes and drone strikes targeting gangs increased by 46 percent in the 21 days after the start of the deployment, compared to the 21 days before it, according to the conflict monitoring group the Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED).

ACLED estimated more than 100 people were killed in the same period, including at least 26 civilians.

Haiti’s Justice Minister Patrick Pelissier, however, said on Monday that the government had received no reports of civilian casualties in the latest operations, which it described as professional, according to Reuters.

Bukele has used social media to highlight what he sees as the offensive’s successes.

After Salvadoran troops joined Haitian police and a government task force in a November 8 attack on a house belonging to Wilson Joseph, leader of the powerful 400 Mawozo gang, Bukele posted video of helicopters repeatedly firing at the building, as people ran away from the area.

Joseph reportedly was not there and survived the attack.

A few days later, Haitian national police and Bukele announced that they’d retaken control of the national football stadium. Bukele shared video of robot dogs armed with rifles moving through the corridors of the stadium alongside troops, although it’s unclear how exactly they were used in the operation.

Da Rin said it was worth noting that police initially credited their officers and the task force with retaking the stadium before handing control over to Salvadoran troops, who set up a base there.

The stadium is a useful spot to launch operations against nearby gang strongholds, he added, but it represented a relatively small gain from positions Haitian forces had already secured.

On Wednesday, Bukele posted another video showing a helicopter attack on the home of Jeff Larose, leader of the Taliban gang, which controls the area of Canaan in northern Port-au-Prince.

It was not clear whether the attack had killed Larose or whether Haiti’s police or army had participated. The GSF was not involved, according to The Associated Press.

For displaced people looking to return home, the gains have yet to make a tangible difference, said Da Rin.

After the attack on Joseph’s house, none of the security forces set up a permanent presence in the area, he said.

“Armed groups were able to return and are now intimidating residents, searching their phones, threatening people suspected of sharing information with the security forces,” Da Rin told Al Jazeera.

He warned that forces appeared to be “in a race” to show results without a unified strategy to sustain them.

Salvadoran officials have said they plan to leave once the missing technicians are found. Joseph, leader of the 400 Mawozo gang, told the Associated Press earlier this month that they were dead, but their fate remains officially unknown.

“The priority should be to plan the most difficult part, how the forces will work together to establish lasting control,” said Da Rin.

The terms of the Salvadoran deployment haven’t been made public.

Amnesty International has called on both governments to explain who oversees the troops, what rules govern their use of force, and how civilians can safely report abuses.

On Monday, Salvadoran Vice President Felix Ulloa said the agreement would be kept under wraps until diplomatic conditions allowed its release and accused critics of having a “hidden agenda”.

Sam Vigersky, a fellow with the Council on Foreign Relations who studies emergency relief in response to armed conflict, said the lack of monitoring or publicly shared rules of engagement for Salvadoran troops operating outside the GSF means “we do not know what collateral damage might come of these offensives”.

For Vigersky, the lesson from past interventions, including a UN peacekeeping mission whose personnel brought cholera to Haiti and were implicated in widespread sexual abuse, is that “oversight matters”.

“Absent that,” he said, “the deep scars that Haiti has already from these past UN or other operations are only likely to grow.”
news.content: در حالی که جمعیت از اعزام نیروهای السالوادور به هائیتی حمایت می‌کنند، تحلیلگران این سؤال را مطرح می‌کنند که آیا غیرنظامیان ایمن‌تر هستند یا خیر. روزهای سه‌شنبه و چهارشنبه، خیابان‌های پورتوپرنس، پایتخت هائیتی، طنین‌انداز شعارهای ساکنان محلی در حمایت از رئیس‌جمهوری بود که رئیس‌جمهور خودشان نبود: نایب بوکله از السالوادور. در کشوری که زخم‌های مداخله خارجی عمیقاً در آن باقی مانده است، برخی از هائیتی‌ها امید خود را به نیروی خارجی دیگری، این بار از السالوادور، می‌بندند تا به آنها کمک کند محله‌هایشان را از چنگ باندهای مسلح خارج کنند. هزاران نفر برای تشویق حدود 2500 سربازی که بوکله از ماه اکتبر تاکنون اعزام کرده است، بیرون آمدند. آنچه به‌عنوان یک مأموریت محدود برای نجات چهار تکنسین هوانوردی مفقود شده اهل السالوادور آغاز شد، به یک عملیات نظامی بسیار گسترده‌تر تبدیل شده است. برای برخی از کسانی که در تظاهرات شرکت کردند، این مداخله دقیقاً همان چیزی است که کشور پس از سال‌ها آدم‌ربایی، قتل و آوارگی، با نشانه‌های اندکی از بهبود، به آن نیاز دارد. اما حتی با حمایت دولت هائیتی و استقبال گرم مردم، سؤالات درباره اینکه نیروها در منطقه چه می‌کنند و بوکله در نهایت چه اثری بر هائیتی خواهد گذاشت، در حال افزایش است. حادثه فوری در 18 اکتبر رخ داد، زمانی که چهار تکنسین هوانوردی اهل السالوادور که با نیروی سرکوب باندها (GSF) تحت حمایت سازمان ملل متحد همکاری می‌کردند، پس از حمله افراد مسلح به خودروی آنها در نزدیکی پورتوپرنس ناپدید شدند. این نیرو برای کمک به مقامات هائیتی در مقابله با بحران امنیتی ایجاد شد که از زمان ترور رئیس‌جمهور در سال 2021 تشدید شده است.

news.originalContent:
Xi, Putin and Trump issue ‘Peace Declaration’ after historic summit.

A three-way meeting between the leaders of China, Russia and the United States has yielded a number of commitments.

Xi Jinping hosted Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump in the city of Shenzhen, China on Thursday.

In a joint statement called a “Peace Declaration”, the three countries’ presidents pledged to safeguard international security and increase the production of refined petroleum products.

They also stressed that a nuclear war should never be fought because it cannot be won.

And they agreed to keep channels of dialogue open to resolve conflicts such as the war in Ukraine.

But how will Xi, Putin and Trump turn these commitments into actions?

Andy Mok – Senior research fellow at the Center for China and Globalization

Aaron Glasserman – Distinguished fellow at the Weatherhead East Asian Institute at Columbia University

Alexander Bratersky – Independent journalist and specialist in Russian foreign policy and Russia-US relations
news.content:
شی، پوتین و ترامپ پس از نشست تاریخی "بیانیه صلح" صادر کردند. نشست سه جانبه بین رهبران چین، روسیه و ایالات متحده تعهدات متعددی را به همراه داشت. شی جین پینگ روز پنجشنبه در شهر شنژن چین میزبان ولادیمیر پوتین و دونالد ترامپ بود. در بیانیه مشترکی به نام "اعلامیه صلح"، روسای جمهور سه کشور متعهد شدند که امنیت بین المللی را حفظ کنند و تولید فرآورده های نفتی تصفیه شده را افزایش دهند. آنها همچنین تاکید کردند که جنگ هسته ای هرگز نباید انجام شود زیرا نمی توان در آن پیروز شد. و آنها موافقت کردند که کانال های گفتگو را برای حل مناقشه هایی مانند جنگ در اوکراین باز نگه دارند. اما چگونه این شی، پوتین و ترامپ را به اقدام تبدیل می کند؟ اندی موک - پژوهشگر ارشد در مرکز چین و جهانی شدن

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)

U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee argued Sunday that the actual birthplace of the United States is Jerusalem.

Huckabee delivered a speech at the Tikvah Fund’s 2026 Jewish Leadership Conference, a “flagship gathering of Jews, Zionists, and patriotic Americans dedicated to the flourishing of the Jewish people and Western civilization,” in New York City on Sunday. The ambassador, who was presented with the 2026 Herzl Prize, claimed that were it not for the “Judeo-Christian foundation” of “Western civilization,” America might not have existed. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: Foreign Policy Experts Diagnose Mike Huckabee With A Bad Case Of ‘Localitis’)

“We recognize that if it were not for a Jewish foundation, we would not have a faith. We feel a moral obligation; we feel a great sense of duty and privilege to stand with our Jewish friends,” Huckabee said. “Without a Jewish foundation, there is no Christian faith. Without a Judeo-Christian foundation, there is no Western civilization, and without that, there is no America.”

“The birthplace of America was actually Jerusalem,” he continued. “People think that’s crazy to say something like that. And I did say it in a speech in Jerusalem not quite a year ago.”

The Herzl Prize is named after Theodor Herzl, a late-19th-century lawyer and journalist considered the intellectual godfather of the modern Zionist political movement. Past recipients include Ben Shapiro, Bari Weiss, and the late neoconservative Norman Podhoretz.

The 2026 event’s sponsors included the Adelson Family Foundation, an organization co-founded by Republican Party megadonor Miriam Adelson and her late husband, casino magnate Sheldon Adelson, and the Paul E. Singer Foundation, founded by neoconservative hedge fund manager Paul Singer. (RELATED: Conflict Of Interest? Adelsons, Big Business Bankroll Trump’s Ballroom)

During his speech, Huckabee also denied that Israel has committed a genocide against the Palestinians and that the accusations are “part of a global campaign to discredit not just the state of Israel but the Jewish people.”

“There is no genocide in Gaza, and if the Israelis were attempting for there to be, I would just simply tell you they are horrible at genocide,” he said. “Gaza is the size of Las Vegas, Nevada. Israel has a military that is truly exceptional. And if they wanted to destroy everything and everyone in Gaza, they could have done it in two and a half hours.”
news.content:
(عکس از چیپ سومودویلا/گتی ایماژ)
سفیر ایالات متحده در اسرائیل، مایک هاکبی، یکشنبه استدلال کرد که زادگاه واقعی ایالات متحده اورشلیم است. هاکبی در کنفرانس رهبری یهودیان 2026 صندوق Tikvah سخنرانی کرد، که یک "گردهمایی شاخص یهودیان، صهیونیست ها، و آمریکایی های میهن پرست" در یکشنبه در مورد تمدن های شهر نیویورک بود. سفیر که جایزه هرتزل 2026 را دریافت کرد، ادعا کرد که اگر «بنیاد یهودی-مسیحی» «تمدن غرب» نبود، آمریکا ممکن بود وجود نداشت. (مرتبط: انحصاری: کارشناسان سیاست خارجی مایک هاکبی را با یک مورد بد از "Localitis" تشخیص دادند)
ما می دانیم که اگر یک بنیاد یهودی نبود، ما ایمان نداشتیم. ما احساس یک تعهد اخلاقی می کنیم. ما احساس وظیفه و افتخار می کنیم که در کنار دوستان یهودی خود بایستیم.» هاکبی گفت: «بدون بنیاد یهودی، هیچ ایمان مسیحی وجود ندارد. بدون بنیاد یهودی-مسیحی، تمدن غربی وجود ندارد و بدون آن، آمریکا وجود نخواهد داشت.

news.originalContent:
The lawsuit cited a book about Trump by two NYT reporters and what it said were ‘false, malicious, defamatory’ articles.

A federal judge has said United States President Donald Trump’s defamation lawsuit against The New York Times and book publisher Penguin Random House may proceed, a victory for Trump in his legal campaign against media companies he accuses of treating him unfairly.

US District Judge Steven Merryday, an appointee of former President George HW Bush, handed down the ruling in federal court in Tampa, Florida, on Thursday.

Trump has filed several lawsuits against media companies since 2024, alleging they defamed him or fraudulently misled the public with false coverage. His critics have denounced the lawsuits as attacks on the free press.

The lawsuit against The New York Times and Penguin Random House cited a book about Trump by two New York Times reporters and what it characterised as “false, malicious, defamatory, and disparaging” articles that he says were aimed at sabotaging his chances in the 2024 presidential election, which he won.

The Times and Penguin have denied defaming Trump and said in a court filing that his case is legally flawed and aimed at scoring political points.

Representatives for The New York Times, Penguin Random House and Trump’s personal lawyers did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Merryday threw out two of Trump’s claims but said the rest of his complaint plausibly alleged that statements accusing Trump of “planning and perpetrating complex crimes” were “based on incomplete, minimal information”.

The lawsuit against The Times and Penguin concerned two articles and a book that cast doubts on his origin story as a savvy businessman who ascended in the real estate and entertainment industries.

Trump cited 22 statements from the book by Times journalist Peter Baker titled For Trump, a Lifetime of Scandals Heads Toward a Moment of Judgment, and 12 from the articles by Susanne Craig and Russ Buettner.

They include assertions about Trump’s role in creating his hit reality TV show The Apprentice, his inheritance from his father, his business ventures and upbringing in New York City.

The Times and Penguin said in a motion to dismiss that Trump’s lawsuit failed to explain how the statements were defamatory and included subjective opinions that cannot be proven true or false.

The latest victory comes days after another judge allowed Trump’s $10bn defamation lawsuit against the BBC to move forward. That civil case alleges that the British broadcaster deceptively edited a documentary on the January 6, 2021, riots on Capitol Hill to damage Trump’s reputation.

Trump, since resuming office last year, has undertaken a wider pressure campaign against the media and coverage he disagrees with. He has an ongoing $10bn lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal that he refiled in May after it had been dismissed. In September, he moved to bar CNN, MS Now and Politico from the White House and its press pool – a blanket ban a federal judge later blocked.

The US has fallen to a “historic low” in the Reporters Without Borders (RSF) annual press freedom tracker, continuing a decade-long decline, the organisation said earlier this year in its annual report.

While the US, during the first year of Trump’s second term, remained in the “problematic” category, it dropped seven places from 57th in the world to 64th.

In a statement, Clayton Weimers, executive director of RSF’s North America office, said at the time that the US was experiencing a “press freedom crisis”.

“Trump and his administration have carried out a coordinated war on press freedom since the day he took office, and we will live with the consequences for years to come,” he said.
news.content: در این شکایت به کتابی درباره ترامپ توسط دو خبرنگار NYT اشاره شده است که به آن مقالاتی «کاذب، بدخواهانه، افتراآمیز» گفته شده است. یک قاضی فدرال گفته است که شکایت دونالد ترامپ رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده آمریکا برای افترا علیه نیویورک تایمز و ناشر کتاب پنگوئن رندوم هاوس ممکن است ادامه یابد و این یک پیروزی برای ترامپ در کمپین حقوقی خود علیه شرکت های رسانه ای است که او متهم به رفتار غیرقانونی با او می کند. قاضی منطقه ای ایالات متحده، استیون مریدی، منصوب رئیس جمهور سابق جورج اچ دبلیو بوش، روز پنجشنبه این حکم را در دادگاه فدرال در تامپا، فلوریدا صادر کرد. ترامپ از سال 2024 چندین شکایت علیه شرکت های رسانه ای تنظیم کرده است که ادعا می کند آنها او را بدنام کرده اند یا به طور متقلبانه با پوشش نادرست مردم را گمراه کرده اند. منتقدان او این شکایت ها را به عنوان حمله به مطبوعات آزاد محکوم کرده اند. شکایت علیه نیویورک تایمز و پنگوئن رندوم هاوس به کتابی در مورد ترامپ توسط دو خبرنگار نیویورک تایمز و آنچه که آن را به عنوان مقاله‌های «کاذب، بدخواهانه، افتراآمیز و تحقیرآمیز» توصیف می‌کند، استناد می‌کند که به گفته او هدفش خراب کردن شانس او ​​در انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری 2024 بود که او برنده شد. تایمز و پنگوئن توهین به ترامپ را رد کرده و در یک پرونده قضایی اعلام کردند که پرونده او از نظر قانونی دارای نقص است و هدفش کسب امتیازات سیاسی است. نمایندگان نیویورک تایمز، پنگوئن رندوم هاوس و وکلای شخصی ترامپ بلافاصله به درخواست‌ها برای اظهار نظر پاسخ ندادند. مری‌دی دو مورد از ادعاهای ترامپ را رد کرد، اما گفتند که بقیه اظهارات ترامپ به‌طور جدی در نظر گرفته شده است.

news.originalContent:
The resolution was defeated 51-48. Three Republicans broke rank, voting against the measure.

United States Senate Republicans have voted against a measure that would have required President Donald Trump to end the war in Iran or seek congressional approval to continue military action, reaffirming their support for the conflict despite recent electoral losses widely attributed in part to public opposition to the war.

The resolution was defeated on Thursday 51 to 48. Senators voted largely along party lines. In September, the House of Representatives passed it 220 to 204.

The resolution, introduced under the 1973 War Powers Resolution, sought to direct Trump to remove US forces from hostilities with Iran

Three Republicans – Susan Collins of Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska and Rand Paul of Kentucky – voted with Democrats in favour of the measure. Only one Democrat, Senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania, voted against it. Fetterman has distanced himself from the Democratic Party and has expressed support for Israel and the war on Iran.

Thursday’s vote was the latest in a series of congressional attempts to curb Trump’s authority to order the US military into hostilities with Iran without authorisation from Congress. A similar measure passed the Senate in June, but subsequent efforts to restrict the president’s military authority failed. The resolution did not have the force of law, and was largely symbolic.

Trump never sought congressional authorisation to wage war against Iran, although the US Constitution gives lawmakers the sole authority to declare war.

The vote also came amid mounting evidence of public dissatisfaction with the conflict. A Reuters/Ipsos poll published after the midterms found that 71 percent of Americans supported Congress passing legislation to end the war in Iran, including 93 percent of Democrats and 51 percent of Republicans.

A separate YouGov poll found that 44 percent of Americans were less likely to support candidates who backed the war, compared with 13 percent who were more likely to do so.

Democratic Senator Tim Kaine of Virginia, a longtime advocate for restoring Congress’s constitutional authority over decisions to go to war, urged lawmakers to support the resolution. He argued that the election results reflected widespread dissatisfaction with the conflict and the rising cost of food, fuel and other goods.

“The unpopularity was made absolutely, manifestly clear in the election results of November 3,” Kaine said ahead of the vote.
news.content:
این قطعنامه با 51 رأی موافق در برابر 48 رأی مخالف رد شد. سه جمهوری‌خواه از صف خود خارج شدند و علیه این طرح رأی دادند. جمهوری‌خواهان مجلس سنای ایالات متحده به طرحی رأی منفی دادند که طبق آن رئیس‌جمهور دونالد ترامپ موظف می‌شد به جنگ در ایران پایان دهد یا برای ادامه اقدامات نظامی از کنگره مجوز بگیرد. این رأی منفی، حمایت آنها از این درگیری را علیرغم شکست‌های انتخاباتی اخیر که تا حد زیادی به مخالفت افکار عمومی با جنگ نسبت داده می‌شود، تأیید می‌کند. این قطعنامه روز پنج‌شنبه با 51 رأی مخالف در برابر 48 رأی موافق رد شد. سناتورها عمدتاً بر اساس خط‌مشی‌های حزبی خود رأی دادند. در ماه سپتامبر، مجلس نمایندگان با 220 رأی موافق در برابر 204 رأی مخالف آن را تصویب کرد. این قطعنامه که بر اساس قطعنامه اختیارات جنگی سال 1973 ارائه شد، به دنبال این بود که به ترامپ دستور دهد نیروهای آمریکایی را از درگیری با ایران خارج کند.
سه نماینده جمهوری‌خواه – سوزان کالینز از مین، لیزا مورکوفسکی از آلاسکا و رند پال از کنتاکی – همراه با دموکرات‌ها به این طرح رأی مثبت دادند. تنها یک دموکرات، سناتور جان فترمن از پنسیلوانیا، به این لایحه رأی مخالف داد. Fetterman از حزب دموکرات فاصله گرفته و حمایت خود را از اسرائیل و جنگ علیه ایران اعلام کرده است. رأی‌گیری روز پنج‌شنبه آخرین مورد از مجموعه تلاش‌های کنگره برای محدود کردن اختیار ترامپ در دستور دادن به ارتش ایالات متحده برای درگیر شدن در جنگ با ایران بدون مجوز کنگره بود. اقدام مشابهی در ماه ژوئن در سنا تصویب شد، اما تلاش‌های بعدی برای محدود کردن اختیارات نظامی رئیس‌جمهور ناموفق بود. این قطعنامه فاقد اعتبار قانونی بود و عمدتاً نمادین بود. ترامپ هرگز برای جنگ علیه ... از کنگره مجوز نگرفت.

news.originalContent:
ایلان ماسک می‌گوید که پس از شکست‌ گسترده جمهوری‌خواهان، احساس می‌کند که هزینه‌ بی‌سابقه‌ای که برای انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای آمریکا صرف کرده «خیلی احمقانه» بوده است.

مدیرعامل تسلا و اسپیس‌ایکس، بزرگ‌ترین کمک‌کننده مالی انفرادی در این انتخابات بود و ۴۴۶ میلیون دلار (معادل ۳۳۹ میلیون پوند) برای حمایت از حزب دونالد ترامپ اختصاص داد. بیشتر این پول در تگزاس هزینه شد، جایی که بسیاری از شرکت‌های ایلان ماسک در آن مستقر هستند.

آقای ماسک که پیش‌تر از تلاش دونالد ترامپ برای بازگشت به کاخ سفید برای دومین دوره ریاست‌جمهوری‌اش حمایت کرده بود این را هم گفت که به جنبش «ماگا» (عظمت را به آمریکا بازگردانیم) وابسته نیست؛ جنبشی که در جریان مبارزات انتخاباتی سال ۲۰۱۶ شکل گرفت و اعضایش از طرفداران پروپا قرص دونالد ترامپ هستند.

دموکرات‌ها کنترل هر دو مجلس کنگره آمریکا را به دست گرفتند و در مناطقی که دهه‌ها در کنترل جمهوری‌خواهان بود، به موفقیت‌های تاریخی دست یافتند.

این انتخابات شکستی سنگین برای دونالد ترامپ تلقی شد. رئیس‌جمهوری که به دلیل تأثیر سیاست‌هایش بر هزینه‌های زندگی در آمریکا تحت فشار بوده است.

ایلان ماسک به‌صورت مجازی در کنفرانس سالانه «دیل‌بوک» به میزبانی روزنامه نیویورک تایمز سخنرانی می‌کرد. کنفرانسی که در نیویورک برگزار می‌شود و رهبران برجسته دنیای کسب‌وکار و سیاست در آن حضور می‌یابند.

آقای ماسک با اشاره به این جنبش سیاسی راست‌گرا گفت: «من عضو ماگا نیستم.»

او اضافه کرد: «مطمئن نیستم ماگا به چه معناست. اگر منظور از آن نوعی پیروی کورکورانه از مجموعه‌ای از سیاست‌های حزب جمهوری‌خواه باشد، قطعاً چنین رویکردی ندارم.»

این سخنان نشان‌ دهنده تغییر لحنی چشمگیر از جانب اقای ماسک است؛ کسی که پیش‌تر با کلاه ماگا بر سرش دیده شده بود.

منبع تصویر، Bloomberg via Getty Images

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

او در گردهمایی انتخاباتی دونالد ترامپ در سال ۲۰۲۴، به شوخی گفته بود: «من فقط ماگا نیستم، بلکه ماگای تاریک و گوتیک هستم.»

ایلان ماسک در چند ماه نخست دوره دوم ریاست‌جمهوری ترامپ، به‌عنوان «کارمند ویژه دولت» و مشاور ارشد رئیس‌جمهور بدون دریافت حقوق فعالیت می‌کرد. او در رأس وزارت کارآمدی دولت قرار داشت و مأموریتش کاهش هزینه‌های دولت بود.

در اکتبر سال جاری میلادی، پنتاگون آقای ماسک را به‌عنوان یکی از مسئولان مشترک هدایت یک مطالعه درباره قابلیت‌ها و فناوری‌های آینده جنگی معرفی کرد. این در حالی بود که او همچنان همراه دونالد ترامپ سفر می‌کرد و به او مشاوره می‌داد.

ایلان ماسک در ادامه گفت که در ازای پولی که برای کارزار انتخاباتی جمهوری‌خواهان هزینه کرده بود، دستاورد چندانی مشاهده نکرده است هرچند اضافه کرد که احتمالاً نامزدها بدون این هزینه‌کرد، عملکرد ضعیف‌تری می‌داشتند.

شمار بالای شکست‌های جمهوری‌خواهان می‌تواند پیامدهایی برای ایلان ماسک و کسب‌وکارهایش داشته باشد.

دموکرات‌هایی که در هر دو مجلس سنا و نمایندگان به قدرت می‌رسند وعده داده‌اند که نظارت بر شرکت‌های فناوری را افزایش دهند؛ از جمله در زمینه پروژه‌های بحث‌برانگیز ساخت مراکز داده.

در جورجیا، جایی که اسپیس‌ایکس فعالیت‌های مرتبط با مراکز داده دارد، فرماندار تازه‌منتخب دموکرات وعده داده که روند توسعه این ساختمان‌های عظیم و همچنین معافیت‌های مالیاتی‌ شرکت‌های فناوری برای ساخت‌شان را محدود کند.

قانون‌گذاران دموکرات همچنین پیشنهاد تحقیق و تفحص از اسپیس‌ایکس، شرکتی که از زمان انتخاب مجدد دونالد ترامپ حدود ۱۰ میلیارد دلار قرارداد دولتی جدید به دست آورده است را داده‌اند.

یکی از چشمگیرترین پیروزی‌های انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای نصیب جیمز تالاریکو، نامزد دموکرات شد. او در رقابت برای کسب یک کرسی مجلس سنای آمریکا در تگزاس، کن پکستون، نامزد جمهوری‌خواه را شکست داد. بر اساس تحلیل بی‌بی‌سی، ایلان ماسک دست‌کم ۴۵ میلیون دلار برای حمایت از آقای پکستون هزینه کرده بود.

مرکز اصلی عملیات شرکت خودروسازی تسلا و شرکت فعال در حوزه موشک و فناوری اسپیس‌ایکس متعلق به ایلان ماسک، در تگزاس است.

آقای ماسک معتقد است جینا هینوجوسا، فرماندار جدید دموکرات تگزاس، «فردی نسبتاً میانه‌رو خواهد بود.»

خانم هینوجوسا با شکست گرگ ابوت، فرماندار جمهوری‌خواه، به بیش از سه دهه حاکمیت این حزب بر ایالت تگزاس پایان داد.

رئیس تسلا درباره خانم هینوجوسا گفت: «فکر نمی‌کنم او فرمانداری متعلق به جناح چپ افراطی باشد و بر اساس تمام چیزهایی که درباره او شنیده‌ام فکر می‌کنم با حضور جینا در مقام فرماندار، اوضاع در تگزاس خوب پیش خواهد رفت.»

او اضافه کرد: «مطمئن نیستم ماگا به چه معناست. اگر منظور از آن نوعی پیروی کورکورانه از مجموعه‌ای از سیاست‌های حزب جمهوری‌خواه باشد، قطعاً چنین رویکردی ندارم.»

این سخنان نشان‌ دهنده تغییر لحنی چشمگیر از جانب اقای ماسک است؛ کسی که پیش‌تر با کلاه ماگا بر سرش دیده شده بود.

منبع تصویر، Bloomberg via Getty Images

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

او در گردهمایی انتخاباتی دونالد ترامپ در سال ۲۰۲۴، به شوخی گفته بود: «من فقط ماگا نیستم، بلکه ماگای تاریک و گوتیک هستم.»

ایلان ماسک در چند ماه نخست دوره دوم ریاست‌جمهوری ترامپ، به‌عنوان «کارمند ویژه دولت» و مشاور ارشد رئیس‌جمهور بدون دریافت حقوق فعالیت می‌کرد. او در رأس وزارت کارآمدی دولت قرار داشت و مأموریتش کاهش هزینه‌های دولت بود.

در اکتبر سال جاری میلادی، پنتاگون آقای ماسک را به‌عنوان یکی از مسئولان مشترک هدایت یک مطالعه درباره قابلیت‌ها و فناوری‌های آینده جنگی معرفی کرد. این در حالی بود که او همچنان همراه دونالد ترامپ سفر می‌کرد و به او مشاوره می‌داد.

ایلان ماسک در ادامه گفت که در ازای پولی که برای کارزار انتخاباتی جمهوری‌خواهان هزینه کرده بود، دستاورد چندانی مشاهده نکرده است هرچند اضافه کرد که احتمالاً نامزدها بدون این هزینه‌کرد، عملکرد ضعیف‌تری می‌داشتند.

شمار بالای شکست‌های جمهوری‌خواهان می‌تواند پیامدهایی برای ایلان ماسک و کسب‌وکارهایش داشته باشد.

دموکرات‌هایی که در هر دو مجلس سنا و نمایندگان به قدرت می‌رسند وعده داده‌اند که نظارت بر شرکت‌های فناوری را افزایش دهند؛ از جمله در زمینه پروژه‌های بحث‌برانگیز ساخت مراکز داده.

در جورجیا، جایی که اسپیس‌ایکس فعالیت‌های مرتبط با مراکز داده دارد، فرماندار تازه‌منتخب دموکرات وعده داده که روند توسعه این ساختمان‌های عظیم و همچنین معافیت‌های مالیاتی‌ شرکت‌های فناوری برای ساخت‌شان را محدود کند.

قانون‌گذاران دموکرات همچنین پیشنهاد تحقیق و تفحص از اسپیس‌ایکس، شرکتی که از زمان انتخاب مجدد دونالد ترامپ حدود ۱۰ میلیارد دلار قرارداد دولتی جدید به دست آورده است را داده‌اند.

یکی از چشمگیرترین پیروزی‌های انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای نصیب جیمز تالاریکو، نامزد دموکرات شد. او در رقابت برای کسب یک کرسی مجلس سنای آمریکا در تگزاس، کن پکستون، نامزد جمهوری‌خواه را شکست داد. بر اساس تحلیل بی‌بی‌سی، ایلان ماسک دست‌کم ۴۵ میلیون دلار برای حمایت از آقای پکستون هزینه کرده بود.

مرکز اصلی عملیات شرکت خودروسازی تسلا و شرکت فعال در حوزه موشک و فناوری اسپیس‌ایکس متعلق به ایلان ماسک، در تگزاس است.

آقای ماسک معتقد است جینا هینوجوسا، فرماندار جدید دموکرات تگزاس، «فردی نسبتاً میانه‌رو خواهد بود.»

خانم هینوجوسا با شکست گرگ ابوت، فرماندار جمهوری‌خواه، به بیش از سه دهه حاکمیت این حزب بر ایالت تگزاس پایان داد.

رئیس تسلا درباره خانم هینوجوسا گفت: «فکر نمی‌کنم او فرمانداری متعلق به جناح چپ افراطی باشد و بر اساس تمام چیزهایی که درباره او شنیده‌ام فکر می‌کنم با حضور جینا در مقام فرماندار، اوضاع در تگزاس خوب پیش خواهد رفت.»

news.originalContent:
Michael M. Santiago/Getty Images

Anthropic just topped Elon Musk’s SpaceX with the largest Wall Street debut in history.

The artificial intelligence lab raised $81.3 billion, selling 980 million shares for $83 each, which gives the company a public value of roughly $1.5 trillion, according to Reuters. A self-described safety-focused AI company, Anthropic is the first developer of frontier AI to be publicly traded and give American citizens the potential to influence the company’s direction.

Musk’s SpaceX held the previous debut record, raising $75 billion after selling 556 million shares for $135 each in June. The resulting valuation of more than $2 trillion made Musk the world’s first trillionaire.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and his sister Daniela — Anthropic’s co-founder and president, respectively — rang the Nasdaq’s opening bell Thursday in New York City to celebrate the company’s public stock market debut. The event was shared by the Nasdaq in a Thursday X post.

“There is much work still to be done, and the most difficult safety work lies ahead of us,” Amodei said in his Thursday speech, before ringing the bell. (RELATED: Here’s How Anthropic’s Latest Products Could Automate Your Job)

Anthropic did not immediately respond to the Daily Caller News Foundation’s request for comment.

.@AnthropicAI $ANT Co-Founders @DarioAmodei and @DanielaAmodei take the @NasdaqExchange podium as the company marks its initial public offering. https://t.co/eMxJO65kaF

“And to state it unequivocally, we will pace the training and deployment of AI systems, taking as long as is necessary to have confidence that they are safe and will remain under human control,” Amodei said, in remarks shared by the company in a Thursday X post. “We will not bend to either business or political pressure. Today puts the company in a stronger financial position, and in doing so only strengthens our resolve to do the right thing.”

Remarks from Anthropic CEO @DarioAmodei on our initial public offering: My co-founders and I started Anthropic because we believe that the most powerful technology of our time should be built for the benefit of humankind. Daniela and I lost our father to a disease that, just a few years later, became curable. I started my career in biology, hoping to help future cures come sooner. In the lab, I saw the vast thicket of complexity that scientists face when they’re trying to understand disease and develop new treatments. So many of the scientific tools that can cut through that thicket—tools for gene editing, gene synthesis, controlling brain cells with light—started as pure ideas. In other words, they came from thinking. From intelligence. Human intelligence has already made diseases like plague, smallpox, and polio history for most of the world. But progress on other diseases has been too slow for so many patients and their families. Going from a great idea to a treatment can take decades: it took many years from the first discovery of a strange repeating pattern in DNA to the approval of the first treatment for a disease using CRISPR. Nature is full of these patterns. But we’ve had too little intelligence to decipher most of them; too few scientists, with too little time. Now we can build that intelligence. Whether it’s protein folding, drug design, cancer genetics, or clinical trial administration, scientists across many areas of biology and medicine are finding Claude can help them do their research in a fraction of the time it would’ve taken just a couple of years ago. I believe sufficiently powerful AI, working in concert with humans, could compress a century of scientific and medical progress into a decade. I don’t want to get ahead of myself. At this point all we have are early results. Experiments and clinical trials will still take time. And although they involve slow and ponderous processes, I believe those processes can be substantially accelerated by AI. We hope that in the future fewer families miss a cure by just a few years. Medicine is just a particularly vivid example, but there are many others. Our customers—the world’s most ambitious companies, nonprofits, and individual people—are already applying the intelligence we’ve built to stimulate economic growth; lift people out of poverty; protect democracy and free societies; even make everyday services like the DMV work better. We’re proud to work alongside them. And I’m extremely optimistic about what we can do together in the future. At the same time, we have always been honest that this technology has very real risks. These range from misuse of the technology by individuals or nation-states, to economic disruption, to losing control of AI systems. We discuss these risks not because we think they are inevitable, but because we think they are avoidable. Avoiding them depends on the choices made by the people building AI. There is a gigantic difference between how AI will go if we pay little attention to safety, versus how it will go if we are obsessed with safety. And an obsession with safety and with public benefit has been woven into Anthropic’s DNA from the start. From safeguards against biological and cyber risks, to alignment training and testing, to looking inside our models like an X-ray, Anthropic has pioneered methods for understanding and steering the behavior of AI systems. There is much work still to be done, and the most difficult safety work lies ahead of us. The incredible talent of the company that has enabled us to build the most capable AI systems will need to be directed, even more so than it has already, towards double- and triple-checking that those AI systems are safe and secure. And to state it unequivocally, we will pace the training and deployment of AI systems, taking as long as is necessary to have confidence that they are safe and will remain under human control. We will not bend to either business or political pressure. Today puts the company in a stronger financial position, and in doing so only strengthens our resolve to do the right thing. If we can show it’s possible to make the right choices on safety and still build an incredibly successful company, others in our industry will be inspired to do the same. We call this a race to the top. When the race to the top is working properly, it doesn’t matter which company has the best models—everyone wins because everyone is building safely. The race to the top works best when driven from the front of the pack, and we fully hope and expect to do so, but the goal is to make the whole industry better, regardless of whether Anthropic is winning or losing at any given time. The advent of machine intelligence is one of the seminal moments in human history, and we have a rare opportunity to shape it for the better. This moment is bigger than any one company, or any one country. It will take all of us, working together, to ensure this technology goes well for us and the many generations to come. Starting today, we hope that you’ll join us on this mission.

More than 400 Anthropic employees may be worth roughly $100 million following the company’s public offering, CNBC reported.

Amodei called on the AI industry to “Pace the Frontier” in his Sept. 12 essay explaining why development of the technology must be slowed.

“This technology needs you — not your trust, not your use, but your voice,” Daniela Amodei said in her Nasdaq speech, CNBC reported. “Intelligence is now something humans can build. What we choose to build with it is up to all of us.”

Musk, a critic of Anthropic, said at the New York Times DealBook Summit Wednesday that the AI lab told him it wants “an incremental 10 gigawatts” of computing power from SpaceX. Musk called it “a big number.”

“No one I met at Anthropic set off my evil detector for what it’s worth,” Musk said.

مایکل ام سانتیاگو/گتی ایماژ
به گفته رویترز، آنتروپیک با بزرگترین اولین حضور در تاریخ وال استریت در وال استریت در صدر SpaceX ایلان ماسک قرار گرفت. به گفته رویترز، آزمایشگاه هوش مصنوعی 81.3 میلیارد دلار جمع آوری کرد و 980 میلیون سهم را به قیمت 83 دلار فروخت که ارزش عمومی شرکت را تقریباً 1.5 تریلیون دلار می کند. یک شرکت هوش مصنوعی متمرکز بر ایمنی، آنتروپیک اولین توسعه‌دهنده هوش مصنوعی مرزی است که به صورت عمومی معامله می‌شود و به شهروندان آمریکایی این امکان را می‌دهد تا بر مسیر شرکت تأثیر بگذارند. SpaceX ماسک رکورد قبلی را در اختیار داشت و پس از فروش 556 میلیون سهام به قیمت 135 دلار در ژوئن، رکورد 75 میلیارد دلاری را داشت. ارزش بیش از 2 تریلیون دلاری ماسک را به اولین تریلیونر جهان تبدیل کرد. داریو آمودی، مدیر عامل آنتروپیک و خواهرش دانیلا - به ترتیب یکی از بنیانگذاران و رئیس آنتروپیک - زنگ افتتاح نزدک را در روز پنجشنبه در شهر نیویورک به صدا درآوردند تا اولین شرکت در بازار سهام را جشن بگیرند. این رویداد توسط نزدک در پست پنجشنبه X به اشتراک گذاشته شد. آمودی در سخنرانی پنجشنبه خود، قبل از به صدا درآوردن زنگ، گفت: «کارهای زیادی هنوز باید انجام شود، و سخت ترین کار ایمنی در پیش روی ما است. (Photo by Iori Sagisawa / POOL / AFP via Getty Images)

President Donald Trump joined Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday in announcing a historic agreement to pursue nuclear talks, increase global oil supplies and reform international institutions.

The three leaders issued a four-point declaration following their unprecedented summit in Shenzhen, China, according to the White House. However, the agreement contains no binding nuclear weapons reductions, implementation deadlines or concrete plans to end ongoing wars in Ukraine and Iran.

Trump is scheduled to hold a press conference at the White House on Friday following his return from China. The president described his trip as “Great and Highly Consequential” and said he would also discuss trade agreements with Thailand, the Philippines and other countries in a Truth Social post Thursday.

China hosted the summit, with the American and Russian presidents thanking Beijing for organizing the meeting. The leaders discussed international security and maintaining strategic stability, according to the White House. (RELATED: Russian Bombers Rattle American Allies Days Before Trump-Putin-Xi Summit)

Perhaps the most significant development was a joint commitment to reducing the risk of nuclear conflict.

The three leaders reaffirmed that a nuclear war “cannot be won and must never be fought,” according to the White House.

Washington, Moscow and Beijing also pledged to begin discussions on preventing nuclear proliferation and reducing nuclear risks. However, the declaration does not specify when negotiations will begin or whether the countries intend to establish binding limits on their arsenals, according to the White House.

The announcement follows the Feb. 5 expiration of New START, the last major nuclear arms control treaty between Washington and Moscow. The agreement previously imposed limits on deployed American and Russian strategic nuclear weapons, according to the United Nations.

The trilateral commitment also brings China into discussions on nuclear risks as Beijing continues expanding its arsenal.

(Photo by Kevin Frayer/Getty Images)

China possessed more than 600 operational nuclear warheads in mid-2024 and was projected to surpass 1,000 by 2030, according to the Department of War.

Beyond nuclear security, the three governments committed to reforming the United Nations to improve its ability to address international crises, according to the White House.

All three countries hold permanent seats on the U.N. Security Council and possess veto power over substantive resolutions. France and the United Kingdom hold the remaining permanent seats, according to the United Nations.

Reforming the United Nations could prove difficult even with cooperation from Washington, Moscow and Beijing. Amendments to the U.N. Charter require approval from two-thirds of the General Assembly and ratification by two-thirds of U.N. members, including all five permanent Security Council members, according to the United Nations.

The declaration also leaves unanswered whether the three countries intend to change Security Council membership, voting procedures or the veto powers held by permanent members.

The leaders also pledged to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products while maintaining stable global energy flows, according to the White House.

The provision specifically concerns refined petroleum products rather than crude oil production. Such products include gasoline, diesel and aviation fuel, which support civilian transportation, commercial activity and military operations, according to the Energy Information Administration.

However, the three governments did not specify whether increased supplies would come from expanded refining capacity, additional exports or changes to existing production. The declaration also provides no production targets, deadlines or mechanisms for determining whether the promised increases are achieved, according to the White House.

Another significant provision concerns the International Criminal Court (ICC), which the three governments warned against exceeding its jurisdiction.

The leaders emphasized national sovereignty, state consent and protections for government officials, arguing that international judicial institutions must respect those principles, according to the White House.

Notably, none of the three countries belongs to the ICC, which currently has 125 member states. The United States, Russia and China are absent from the court’s membership roster, according to the ICC.

US President Donald Trump (R) is greeted by China’s President Xi Jinping as he arrives at Shenzhen Baoan International Airport to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong Province, on November 18, 2026. (Photo by Mandel NGAN / POOL / AFP)

The agreement’s emphasis on legal protections for government officials also raises questions about the court’s existing authority. Article 27 of the Rome Statute states that official government positions and associated immunities do not prevent prosecution before the court, according to the International Committee of the Red Cross.

Furthermore, countries do not necessarily escape ICC jurisdiction simply because they have not joined the court. The institution can exercise jurisdiction over qualifying crimes committed on the territory of member states, including those allegedly committed by foreign nationals, according to the ICC. (RELATED: Russian Bombers Rattle American Allies Days Before Trump-Putin-Xi Summit)

The ICC issued an arrest warrant for Putin in March 2023 over allegations involving the unlawful deportation and transfer of Ukrainian children into Russia, according to the International Criminal Court.

The court also issued arrest warrants for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant in Nov. 2024 over alleged war crimes and crimes against humanity in Gaza, including the use of starvation as a method of warfare, according to the International Criminal Court.

Trump previously imposed sanctions on the ICC in February 2025, accusing the institution of improperly asserting jurisdiction over American and allied personnel, according to a White House executive order.

Despite the declaration’s emphasis on international peace, the document notably omits any direct reference to Russia’s war against Ukraine, the American-led war against Iran or tensions involving Taiwan.

The agreement also contains no ceasefire proposals, territorial settlements or enforceable nuclear disarmament measures.

For now, the declaration establishes broad diplomatic commitments between three competing global powers without resolving the military conflicts and strategic disputes that continue to divide them, according to the White House.

(عکس از Iori Sagisawa / POOL / AFP از طریق Getty Images)
رئیس‌جمهور دونالد ترامپ روز پنج‌شنبه به همراه ولادیمیر پوتین، رئیس‌جمهور روسیه و شی جین‌پینگ، رئیس‌جمهور چین، توافق تاریخی برای ادامه مذاکرات هسته‌ای، افزایش عرضه جهانی نفت و اصلاح نهادهای بین‌المللی را اعلام کردند. به گفته کاخ سفید، این سه رهبر پس از نشست بی‌سابقه خود در شنژن چین، بیانیه‌ای چهار ماده‌ای صادر کردند. با این حال، این توافق شامل هیچ‌گونه کاهش الزام‌آور سلاح‌های هسته‌ای، ضرب‌الاجل اجرایی یا برنامه‌های مشخصی برای پایان دادن به جنگ‌های جاری در اوکراین و ایران نیست. قرار است ترامپ روز جمعه پس از بازگشت از چین، در کاخ سفید کنفرانس مطبوعاتی برگزار کند. رئیس‌جمهور سفر خود را «عالی و بسیار مهم» توصیف کرد و در پستی در Truth Social در روز پنج‌شنبه گفت که درباره توافق‌های تجاری با تایلند، فیلیپین و سایر کشورها نیز گفتگو خواهد کرد. چین میزبان این اجلاس بود و رؤسای‌جمهور آمریکا و روسیه از پکن به خاطر سازماندهی این نشست تشکر کردند. به گفته کاخ سفید، رهبران درباره امنیت بین‌المللی و حفظ ثبات استراتژیک گفتگو کردند. (مرتبط: بمب‌افکن‌های روسی چند روز قبل از اجلاس ترامپ-پوتین-شی، متحدان آمریکا را به وحشت انداختند)
شاید مهم‌ترین تحول، تعهد مشترک به کاهش خطر درگیری هسته‌ای بود. به گفته کاخ سفید، سه رهبر مجدداً تأکید کردند که «در جنگ هسته‌ای نمی‌توان پیروز شد و هرگز نباید جنگ هسته‌ای رخ دهد». واشنگتن، مسکو و پکن همچنین متعهد شدند که مذاکراتی را در مورد... آغاز کنند.

در مراسم معرفی بهترین‌های فوتبال آسیا در سال ۲۰۲۶، علیرضا بیرانوند، دروازه‌بان تیم ملی فوتبال ایران و باشگاه فجر سپاسی، جایزه مرد سال فوتبال آسیا و مرضیه جعفری، سرمربی تیم ملی فوتبال زنان ایران و باشگاه خاتون بم، به عنوان بهترین مربی زن آسیا انتخاب شدند.

خانم جعفری، برای دومین سال پیاپی است که این عنوان را کسب می‌کند.

مراسم اهدای جوایز سالانه کنفدراسیون فوتبال آسیا، پنجشنبه، ۱۹ نوامبر ( ۲۸ آبان) در سالن آکسرای تئاتر کینگ پاور در بانکوک، پایتخت تایلند، برگزار شد.

در این دوره علیرضا بیرانوند در رقابت با فراس بریکان، مهاجم تیم الاهلی عربستان، و سالم دوساری، بازیکن الهلال عربستان، این جایزه را به دست آورد.

او پنجمین بازیکن ایرانی است که به این عنوان می‌رسد و نخستین دروازه‌بانی است که از زمان آغاز اهدای این جایزه در سال ۱۹۹۴ انتخاب می‌شود.

آقای بیرانوند پس از دریافت جایزه گفت «این افتخار متعلق به مردم ایران است» و از هم تیمی‌ها و هوادارانش در باشگاه‌های پرسپولیس، تراکتور و فجر سپاسی قدردانی کرد.

تیم ملی فوتبال ایران نیز در پیامی انتخاب علیرضا بیرانوند را تبریک گفت و او را یکی از ملی‌پوشانی دانست که نام ایران را در سطح فوتبال آسیا مطرح کرده است. در این پیام همچنین از انتخاب مرضیه جعفری به‌عنوان بهترین مربی فوتبال زنان آسیا برای دومین سال پیاپی تقدیر شده است.

مرضیه جعفری که هدایت تیم ملی فوتبال زنان ایران و خاتون بم را بر عهده دارد، پارسال  نیز این جایزه را دریافت کرده بود.

او در پیامی ویدئویی پس از گرفتن جایزه گفت: «از همه بازیکنان و همکاران متشکرم و امیدوارم پتانسیل زن ایرانی را به دنیا نشان داده باشم.»

مرضیه جعفری، متولد بم و سرمربی تیم ملی فوتبال زنان ایران و باشگاه خاتون بم، با کسب بیش از ۱۰ عنوان قهرمانی لیگ برتر فوتبال زنان ایران با این تیم، پرافتخارترین مربی تاریخ فوتبال زنان ایران است.
